purpose: Run the already prepared complete24 speech-completion comparison after the sole zone-F attempt failed before any GPU/model start. One placement fallback, not a training run or repeated optimizer updates.

compute.only_advance_after: Authoritative capacity-only stockout with no lastStartTimestamp; retire failed envelope first. Any actual GPU start consumes the ONE interval; no second model run or restart.

storage.window: Immutable claim before first storage operation after approval; never reset. Fresh current price/copy/ancestry/retention checks before any mutation.
storage.cleanup: Full pretransfer inventory and hash-verified copyback outside OneDrive in <=32MiB rsync batches before removing only new temporary envelopes/active snapshot. Stop billed compute early; preserve unverified unique results on failure.

evaluation.acceptance: No weaker thresholds/subsets; all repaired12 WER<=.05 and peak<=.995, actual EOS/no incomplete tails and full copyback. Not full behavior, voice, latency or product adoption.

source_deployment: Git only; same approved candidate466 checkpoint/recipe <=200MB and existing synthetic artifacts. No owner conversations, credentials, private files or core dumps.
approval_scope: Replaces exhausted prestart placement permission only; do not combine grants, repeat saved updates or infer wider training authorization. No resources under this proposal until approved.
